title: resourceEnvironment
responsibility: Selects only lease and worker-budget variables for propagation alongside a separately filtered application environment.

inputs.name: resourceEnvironment.env
inputs.description: The environment record to read for the nine recognized resource and worker keys; all other entries are ignored and never returned, and values are copied as given with no path resolution or range checks. It matters when resource context is propagated to a subprocess separately from application configuration, and it defaults to process.env when the argument is undefined.

outputs.name: resourceEnvironment
outputs.description: The subset of the nine recognized resource and worker keys that are set, in the order they are listed in the source, each with its value copied unchanged; keys whose value is undefined are omitted, so the result is an empty object when none are set. It is the resource context that is propagated separately from a subprocess's application configuration.
